krdsIscDiscrepancy.readmeStatement: 본 패키지는 대한민국 디지털 정부 디자인 시스템(KRDS)의 이용약관을 따름.
krdsIscDiscrepancy.resolution: Preserve both statements and verified official attribution terms. Do not assert an ISC/KOGL choice, remove attribution, or assert one document always legally prevails. Individually conflicting notices require local exclusion.
